text: Dakar director David Castera confirmed an agreement keeping the rally in Saudi Arabia until at least 2029, after the initial exclusive deal was set to expire after the 2024 edition, saying other countries might be added to future routes.

source.name: Motorsport.com (Spanish edition) - El Rally Dakar se quedara en Arabia Saudi hasta 2029
source.note: Castera: 'Hasta el 2029, y puede ser con otros paises tambien'. Host fee not mentioned in the article.
